=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "If work must be split, create a security-labelled successor bound to the original finding and retain the block until its fix is verified merged." (linked issue #6541 recommendation)
  Expected change site: `scripts/unblock_actions.py` lines 388-402 (the `reissue` branch when `ctx["tracking"]` is set) and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` lines 16955-16960 (`handle_unblock_judge_project_hooks` issuing `gh issue create` for the fix-up request)
  Evidence of absence: For a tracked security finding that gets a `reissue` verdict, `scripts/unblock_actions.py` lines 377-381 only add the security finding marker, target-branch and depends-on metadata when `not ctx["tracking"]`; lines 388-402 only comment on the tracking issue, never creating a successor issue with the `ai:security` label. The poller then materializes the fix-up at lines 16955-16960 with `--label "ai:clarification" --label "ai:orchestrator-managed"` only — no `ai:security` label and no finding marker carried over. The original stays blocked, but the successor is unlabelled and unbound, so a security finding can be split into a generic managed issue that the orchestrator can resolve without ever touching the security label.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
